fusions.name: Snapping Reach
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 4 damage, harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Venomous Vault
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the first enemy ahead and strike it for 12 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pad Skip
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds, and you hop 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Desperate Bound
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
